contents.entry: Purpose and the one rule: only the innermost layer retries a failure
The layers: owner, maximum tries, parent, the failure classes each retries
The operations that leave the host, their keys and the lookup before a repost
The budgets: per unit per head, per ticket, per day
The deadlines and how they nest

pointers.sibling: Who retries what and whether an attempt is charged; this volume is the composition of that table
Effects written in the deciding Commit; the external lookup before a repost
pointers.shared: Plan attempts and the status post
Enforces the per-ticket and daily budgets

purpose.s: Book 1.0.0 had seventeen retry layers stacked with no composition: a 5-rung pod ladder inside 3 plan attempts inside 3 gate re-dispatches inside 3 worker attempts, up to 135 pods per unit per ticket and no global cap; deadlines were inverted, so N-08 declared a gate missing after 3600 s while one N-25 attempt could run 3 hours (review F26; verification NF-E5).
purpose.rule: Only the innermost layer retries a given failure class. A layer that gives up emits its own exhausted class (for example ladder-exhausted); the parent retries that class only when its row lists it, and no class appears in the retries-on list of two layers.
purpose.s: max is the number of tries including the first, so max 1 means the layer never retries; parent is the layer whose one try contains this layer's tries, or none.
A test assertion, a review verdict, a refused plan and a 403, 409 or 412 from the store are results, never retried by any layer (V05; shared/contracts.xml#retry-owner).
Every runtime proof is not-run until the build ticket citing the anchor lands it.

layer.retries-on: unschedulable image-pull checkout connect-timeout agent-lost provision

layers.layer: Rungs 1 to 3 after 10, 30, 90 s, rung 4 a clean re-run after 300 s, rung 5 the report (nodes/N-24/spec.xml#m-ladder); admission-refused is not in the list: it ends the unit at once (ci-capacity.xml#admission).
A fresh coq-gate build of the same plan (nodes/N-25/spec.xml#m-attempts); after the second, coq/gate error and one card.

The gate phase of a head is never re-dispatched after N-25 has given up; a missing gate verdict past its derived deadline (#deadlines d-gate-pending) is gate.verdict missing and one card, not a new gate run.
One planner job per try with N-11 backoff; then plan.refused 412 diff-unavailable or plan.blocked 423 jenkins-queue and one card.
The outbox effect that posts buildWithParameters; before every repost the worker looks for COQ_OP_ID in the queue and the builds (#operations gate.run).
Fetching gate-result.jsonl, unit logs and records/*.jsonl after the build.
The outbox effect that posts coq/gate with the coq-gate GitHub App; a read of the statuses for the sha and context comes before every repost; then status.post.failed 500 and one card.
check.sh exit 0, 1 or 2 is a result of the unit; only the pod around it climbs pod-ladder.

layer.retries-on: phase.failed stall crashed no_result schema_invalid output_rejected seat_blocked error_max_turns error_max_budget

layers.layer: One row for each seat phase: worker, reviewer and spec-author have 3 attempts each (shared/contracts.xml#retry-owner); a review.changes verdict routes to the worker and is the worker's next attempt, not a reviewer retry; harness_mismatch is never retried and charges nothing (the ticket waits with one card, shared/contracts.xml#retry-owner).

The dark-build validator's infrastructure only (cannot_run is a 422 refusal, a result, never retried); validator-exhausted is not in seat-attempt's list, so a broken validator never burns seat attempts.
Fix tickets cut for one red main; each fix ticket has its own seat-attempt budget and the per-ticket budget below.
The store client used by every node retries only transport failures with the same operation key; a replay is answered by the idempotency row (shared/contracts.xml#operation-keys).
A fresh coq-image build or host leg per try (nodes/N-22/spec.xml#retries).
ci/image/build.sh's own loop on the host leg; registry-timeout from an exhausted host build is retried by image-job once per job try.
Check attempts per gitops sha.
One HTTP or kube call inside a check; backoff 2, 4, 8 s.
Check attempts per gitops sha; a dry-run refusal or a failed probe is a result (namespace.unready at once), not a retry.
One kube call inside a check.
The Kubernetes plugin's own re-provisioning is cut by the connect timeout, so the plugin never adds pods beyond a rung.
One deletion of one path.
One backup class run.
The CLI's own API retries inside one seat run are bounded by run.deadline and are part of that one attempt; the launcher adds none.

operations.s: An operation that leaves the host is an outbox effect written in the Commit that decides it (shared/contracts.xml#outbox); its operation key is the effect's op_id and travels with the external call, so a repost can find the first post.

operation.lookup: GET /queue/api/json and GET /job/coq-gate/api/json?tree=builds[number,actions[parameters[name,value]]] filtered by COQ_OP_ID, before every repost; a queue item URL expires 5 minutes after its build starts, so the builds list is always read too

operations.operation: N-26 uses the same shape under its own node segment for main.

operation.lookup: queue and builds of coq-image by COQ_OP_ID; GHCR HEAD on the leg tag for an already-pushed leg
GET /repos/jkkelley/coq-jev-herdr-plugin/commits/<sha>/statuses filtered by context coq/gate and creator the coq-gate app; equal state and description is done

operation.key: none: the Jenkins plugin creates pods inside a build
operation.carries: pod name with sha12, unit hash, plan attempt and rung
operation.lookup: the plugin owns the pod; a rung never reuses a name

budgets.budget: 5 rungs x 2 plan attempts; gate-phase adds none.
Three worker heads at most, each with its own gate; N-07 refuses to dispatch a planner or a plan attempt that would pass it (plan.blocked 423 reason budget, one card).
The sum of total_cost_usd over every seat.result of the ticket; N-07 refuses GrantDispatch past it (lease not granted, one card).
UTC day; past it N-07 grants no seat lease except a system-epic ticket until the next day or an owner ruling; three tickets at the per-ticket cap; owner-tunable.
UTC day, summed from pod.run durations and rung waits; past it N-07 plans no new gate run except main; half of container-cap 6 x 1440 minutes (ci-capacity.xml#model); owner-tunable.
budgets.s: The four budget keys are N-07 config (shared/state-store.xml#config-keys, defaults in shared/contracts.xml#timing); this volume states what they mean.

Worst cases that remain, stated so nobody rediscovers them: a herdr plan of 31 units costs at most 310 pods per head and 930 per ticket; a red main costs at most 3 fix tickets, each under the per-ticket caps.

deadlines.s: Grammar for C28: derived-from lists the ids of the deadlines this one waits for, an id repeated once per sequential try; the row holds when value-seconds is at least the sum of theirs; an empty list is a leaf whose basis is the text; truncates names the deadline that cuts a row short instead of waiting for it.
deadlines.deadline: The Jenkins agent connect timeout (slaveConnectTimeout) of 5 minutes.
The budget_minutes cap of 30 (p95 x 1.5, floor 5).
The 5 minutes after the test timeout so w3 always fires before the kubelet.
(connect 5 + budget + 5) x 60 at the budget cap.

deadline.derived-from: d-pod d-pod d-pod d-pod d-pod d-ladder-waits

deadlines.deadline: Five pods each to its deadline plus the waits; the build bound cuts it short.
Sum of budgets / maxPods + 1800, capped at PT3H.
N-24 w6: the plan bound plus 10 minutes.
The Go service follows the build to its bound plus slack, then stops it.
N-23 w3 PT10M.
N-24 w7, 60 s per file, 3 tries, the result file and the records files.
Queue, build followed to its bound, artifacts imported.
Min(10 s x 2^(n-1), 5 min).
3 calls of 10 s with 2, 4, 8 s backoff, plus outbox worker ticks.
Two plan attempts, one backoff, the final post.
N-23 stall bound PT15M.
Three planner tries and two backoffs.
A posted status is in a fresh snapshot within this bound.
The pending status is posted once the plan has a build number; derived, replaces the 1800 default.
The gate-missing bound: a terminal status follows within the gate run bound; derived, replaces the 3600 default.
A non-final error is followed by N-25's next plan attempt inside the gate run bound, so it ages out on the same bound as pending; derived, replaces the 900 default.
The main plan uses the same planner and gate run bounds.
CANON F13: N-26 plan bound plus 600 s.
The verify bound; derived, replaces the 3600 default.
deadlines.s: Seat deadlines (run.deadline_seconds, stall, start and kill grace) are in shared/contracts.xml#timing and nest inside one seat-attempt; they do not compose with the CI chain because a seat never waits on a gate.

The CI deadlines are long because a build may legitimately run 3 hours; the derived N-08 and N-10 bounds are the honest consequence, and shrinking them means shrinking d-build, never cutting a deadline below its inner sum.

many-agents.readers: Every node that retries cites its layer row by id; a reviewer checks a new retry against #innermost before anything else.
many-agents.writers: A new layer or a changed maximum is one ticket on this file; C27 recomputes the budgets from the layer rows and refuses a class listed by two layers, and C28 refuses a deadline below its inner sum.
many-agents.collision: Two tickets changing two layers at once both declare this file and run in order (N-14); a node volume that states its own retry count instead of citing a row is a review finding.
